accepted: Correct bounded partial results and exact finite verification
excluded: No copied source bodies, dataset contents, private sources, private personal data, private coordination material or its identifying metadata.
historical_metadata: All source checks and execution receipts in author/ and audit/ remain unchanged historical records. New publication replay does not repeat absent-source or dataset checks.
remaining_gaps: FPT bound in the number of interior points
scope_of_replay: Only the included authored proofs, code, fixtures, outputs and verification metadata; absent source/corpus bodies are not required or rechecked.
